steps.content:
Based on the two listings, **there's no meaningful reason to choose one over the other** — they're identical apart from the seller name:

|  | A: Brackmoor Sound | B: Ottervale Audio |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Customer rating** | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| **Shipping** | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| **Returns** | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| **Product** | Quellwyn Stillwave H2, graphite | Quellwyn Stillwave H2, graphite |

The specifications and box contents — 40-hour battery life, Bluetooth 5.3, carry case, USB-C and 3.5mm cables — are exactly the same too.

**Recommendation:** Buy from either one. If you need a tie-breaker, just pick the first listing (Brackmoor Sound), but you won't be getting a better deal, faster shipping, or better protection than with Ottervale Audio. The only thing worth double-checking at checkout is that no extra fees appear before you pay, since none are shown on either listing page.
